title: Review
summary: Findings or candidates for one reviewer to accept or send back by number. Facet vocabulary arrives with the skill; any labels pass for now.

summary_table.legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

pick.title: How to reply
pick.markdown: Reply with the numbers you approve, for example `1, 3`, and a note on anything to revise or block.
